newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank sees profit growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank sees profit growth in 1997.

text.p: Commerzbank AG, Germany's third-largest commercial bank, said on Friday it expected an increase in operating profit in 1997.

Chief executive Martin Kohlhaussen said in the text of a speech prepared for the annual shareholders' meeting that good results achieved in the first quarter and the development in April justified a forecast for profit growth in the full year.
The bank earlier this month reported a 20.5 percent rise in operating profit before provisions to 1.05 billion marks in the first quarter of 1997.
In 1996, Commerzbank increased its net profit by 24 percent to 1.21 billion marks.
